mis_6f0171db2f964fcda0fe65187b67c6b2.goal: Develop physical designs with the best available methods

obs_a5ef72d741674b0aa6a9997673b57d30.summary:
Receiver-owned capability-development need: Develop rough-transport cart designs with a method another lab published
Desired acceptance: Beats the fixed cart by one success on six fresh public instances
An exact network method selection is retained as evidence (169da7af2602adf0d475e4ecd23d36576b591996bbc2a3031f63550780d4d983). It is not an installed Actor capability or an accepted method. Assess continuing responsibility using the existing owners; create a specialist only when distinct continuing work justifies it. Availability alone requires no organizational change.

req_2d1dbd8187ac48c78b5479c284726e25.acceptance: A cart design produced with the method beats the fixed cart by at least one success across six fresh public instances, with the results recorded as evidence.
req_2d1dbd8187ac48c78b5479c284726e25.summary: Develop rough-transport cart designs using the externally published method, evaluating that method for reuse.

rsp_10c34e929dc848abba941635f3441b86.purpose: Develop and evaluate rough-transport cart designs using the published external method, and determine whether the method is worth adopting.
rsp_10c34e929dc848abba941635f3441b86.termination: A design beats the fixed cart by at least one success on six fresh public instances, or the method is judged unsuitable and that judgment is recorded as evidence.
